title: Projects registry
goal: Implement the projects registry: named references to a repository inside a workspace, with create/list/update/delete and strict validation so no filesystem paths or secrets are stored.
scope_in: GET and POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/projects (POST accepts Idempotency-Key), PATCH /v1/projects/{id}, DELETE /v1/projects/{id}.
Fields: `name` 1-60 chars, optional `repo_ref` opaque string <= 256 chars, `created_by`, timestamps; unique `name` per workspace (case-insensitive).
Validation that rejects values that look like local paths, URLs with credentials, or tokens.
Cursor pagination via the B025 library; ETag on resources; audit for create/update/delete.
scope_out: Linking sessions to projects or reading repositories - the server never touches git.
Workspace deletion cascade logic (B027 purge hook calls `deleteForWorkspace` exposed here).
build_against: Fastify app built with the B006 error handler and the B010 test harness (Postgres/Redis containers, factories); routes are called with app.inject() and a test access token; authorisation goes through the B021 RBAC engine; no client is involved.
interfaces: HTTP: the four routes above with shapes from generated CT-API-WORKSPACES types.

TS: `interface ProjectService { list(wspId: string, page: PageRequest): Promise<Page<Project>>; create(wspId: string, actor: Actor, input: ProjectInput): Promise<Project>; update(prjId: string, actor: Actor, patch: Partial<ProjectInput>, ifMatch?: string): Promise<Project>; delete(prjId: string, actor: Actor): Promise<void>; deleteForWorkspace(wspId: string, trx: Trx): Promise<number>; }`
DB: `projects(id prj_, workspace_id, name, name_ci unique per workspace, repo_ref text null, created_by, created_at, updated_at, version)`.
Purge hook name `projects` registered with B027's `registerPurgeHook`.
acceptance: POST as `member` returns 201 with an `ETag`; as `guest` or `billing` returns 403; replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same body and `Idempotency-Replayed: true`.
Names `Api` and `api` in one workspace conflict: second returns 409; same name in two workspaces is fine.

A `repo_ref` of `/home/alex/work/repo`, `~/repo`, `C:\\Users\\a\\repo`, `https://user:pw@github.com/a/b.git`, or one longer than 256 chars returns 422; `github.com/acme/app` and `sha256:ab12...` are accepted.
DELETE as `member` returns 403, as `admin` 204; deleting a project of another workspace returns 404.
List with 120 projects, limit=50 returns 3 pages with stable order and `has_more` true,true,false.
After workspace deletion the purge hook removes all its projects (row count 0).
tests: projects.validation.test.ts: path/credential rejection (table + fuzz), name rules.
guardrails: MUST NOT store local filesystem paths, branch names or credentials; `repo_ref` is an opaque identifier chosen by the client (privacy budget, CT-WS-SESSION-EVENTS).
MUST NOT echo rejected values in error `detail` or logs.
Authorisation MUST go through B021 and use the live membership row; cross-workspace ids MUST yield 404.
Project names MUST NOT appear in any WS frame or relay log (the relay never receives them).
failure_modes: Concurrent create of the same name -> unique index violation mapped to 409, never 500.
notes: CONTRACT GAP: project fields ('named repo references') are not specified; `name` and opaque `repo_ref` are proposed. Recommendation to clients (documentation only): store a hash of the normalised remote, not the URL.
